output.summary: Reported on-time of 98% is largely an artifact of moving promised dates. Revisions per 100 shipments rose from about 2.9 to 14.1. Customer-request revisions stayed flat (1.6 vs 1.8), while capacity-coded, late-entered, mostly un-notified revisions surged. The jumps coincide with bonus eligibility: Northgate and Riverside in March, Pell Junction in July. RouteWise does not fit, since Northgate jumped without it and Pell Junction did not jump at its go-live. The portal does not explain complaints, which rose before it launched. Brightwell's dock data shows on-time against the original date fell from 87% to 81%. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. Hold the bonus increase, the campaign and the driver spend.
